about.en: 施工猫 ("Construction Cat", ticker SUE) is a memecoin launched through the Flap.sh launchpad on BNB Chain. The token contract at 0x2ab8a4dd2191989ac2898006df350b236d2b7777 reads symbol() Sue and name() 施工猫 on chain; it has no utility beyond its community. Unrelated tokens also use the SUE ticker, so it is identified by this contract.
